shortDescription: Deploy a certificate and key to specified locations

options.name: cert_content
options.description: Content of the certificate to write to the certificate file.

options.name: cert_dir
options.description: Directory to store the certificate file.

options.name: cert_group
options.description: Group name or ID to set as the group owner of the certificate file.

options.name: cert_mode
options.description: File permissions for the certificate file.

options.name: cert_owner
options.description: User name or ID to set as the owner of the certificate file.

options.name: key_content
options.description: Content of the key to write to the key file. This is sensitive information and will not appear in logs.

options.name: key_dir
options.description: Directory to store the key file.

options.name: key_group
options.description: Group name or ID to set as the group owner of the key file.

options.name: key_mode
options.description: File permissions for the key file.

options.name: key_owner
options.description: User name or ID to set as the owner of the key file.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the certificate file (e.g., 'example.crt'). The key file name is derived from this by replacing '.crt' with '.key'.
